from datetime import datetime

# Parse the departure date
departure_date_str = "May 22, 2025"
departure_date = datetime.strptime(departure_date_str, "%B %d, %Y").strftime("%Y-%m-%d")

# Parse the return date
return_date_str = "May 28, 2025"
return_date = datetime.strptime(return_date_str, "%B %d, %Y").strftime("%Y-%m-%d")

# Search for outbound flight (Tucson to San Antonio)
outbound_flights = search_flights(
    start_airport_city="Tucson",
    end_airport_city="San Antonio",
    departure_date=[departure_date],
    flight_class=["first"]
)
save_to_cache(key="outbound_flights", value=outbound_flights)

# Search for return flight (San Antonio to Tucson)
return_flights = search_flights(
    start_airport_city="San Antonio",
    end_airport_city="Tucson",
    departure_date=[return_date],
    flight_class=["first"]
)
save_to_cache(key="return_flights", value=return_flights)

# Calculate hotel check-in and check-out dates
checkin_date = departure_date
checkout_date = return_date

# Search for hotel in Downtown San Antonio
hotels = search_hotels(
    city="San Antonio",
    neighborhood=["Downtown"],
    checkin_date=[checkin_date],
    checkout_date=[checkout_date]
)
save_to_cache(key="hotels", value=hotels)
